items.name: WalkParallel
items.summary: WalkParallel is a parallel recursive directory iterator over files paths in one or more directories.

methods.name: run
methods.signature: fn run<'s, F>(self, mkf: F) where F: FnMut() -> Box<dyn FnMut(Result<DirEntry, Error>) -> WalkState + Send + 's>
methods.summary: Execute the parallel recursive directory iterator. `mkf` is called for each thread used for iteration. The function produced by `mkf` is then in turn called for each visited file path.

methods.name: visit
methods.signature: fn visit(self, builder: &mut dyn ParallelVisitorBuilder<'_>)
methods.summary: Execute the parallel recursive directory iterator using a custom visitor.

items.name: ParallelVisitor
items.summary: Receives files and directories for the current thread.

methods.name: visit
methods.signature: fn visit(&mut self, entry: Result<DirEntry, Error>) -> WalkState
methods.summary: Receives files and directories for the current thread. This is called once for every directory entry visited by traversal.

items.name: ParallelVisitorBuilder
items.summary: A builder for constructing a visitor when using [`WalkParallel::visit`]. The builder will be called for each thread started by `WalkParallel`. The visitor returned from each builder is then called for every directory entry.

methods.name: build
methods.signature: fn build(&mut self) -> Box<dyn ParallelVisitor + 's>
methods.summary: Create per-thread `ParallelVisitor`s for `WalkParallel`.
